shoulder.name: Shoulder Charge
shoulder.desc: Armored charge that plows through a crowd.

rising.name: Rising Kick
rising.desc: Invincible anti-air kick. Knocks foes skyward.

heel.name: Heel Drop
heel.how: While in the air, press PUNCH.
heel.desc: Crashing heel that hits wide and floors anyone.

rapid.name: Rapid Fists
rapid.how: Keep pressing PUNCH after your second punch.
rapid.desc: A six-hit flurry before your finisher.

sweep.name: Spin Sweep
sweep.desc: Low spin that trips everyone around you. Beats blockers.

counter.name: Guard Counter
counter.how: After a PERFECT guard, press PUNCH.
counter.desc: Invincible punish right after a perfect guard.

giant.name: Giant Swing
giant.how: While carrying an enemy, press PUNCH.
giant.desc: Spin a carried enemy into everyone nearby, then fling.

retrieve.name: Quick Hands
retrieve.how: Automatic. Grab items instantly; GUARD catches thrown objects.
retrieve.desc: Instant pickups. Guard snatches bottles and bricks out of the air.

slam.name: Thunder Slam
slam.how: While in the air, press GUARD.
slam.desc: Plunge down and send a shockwave across the ground.

oath.name: Oath Breaker
oath.how: Hold KICK for a second, then release.
oath.desc: Benny's secret. An invincible charging kick.
